claims.text: A ClusterRole is a non-namespaced object holding RBAC rules like a Role's; it can name cluster-scoped kinds such as nodes and namespaces, and the same ClusterRole can be referenced by RoleBindings in many namespaces.

claims.text: A ClusterRoleBinding is non-namespaced and grants the referenced ClusterRole to its subjects (users, groups, ServiceAccounts) cluster-wide, in every namespace including ones created later.
claims.source_hint: kubernetes.io: Using RBAC Authorization (RoleBinding and ClusterRoleBinding)

claims.text: A RoleBinding may reference a ClusterRole in roleRef; it then grants the ClusterRole's rules only within the RoleBinding's namespace.

claims.text: A RoleBinding cannot grant cluster-scoped resources such as nodes, whatever its ClusterRole lists; a ClusterRoleBinding can. (Not every cluster-scoped kind: cluster-admin in a RoleBinding covers the binding's own Namespace object.)
